definitions.explanation: A large oceanic fish highly prized in Japanese cuisine, especially for sushi and sashimi. One of the most important fish in Japanese food culture.

examples.japanese: {鮪|まぐろ}の{刺身|さしみ}が{食|た}べたい。
examples.english: I want to eat tuna sashimi.

examples.japanese: {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}で{一番|いちばん}{人気|にんき}のネタは{鮪|まぐろ}だ。
examples.english: The most popular topping at conveyor belt sushi is tuna.

examples.japanese: {築地|つきじ}{市場|しじょう}では{毎朝|まいあさ}{冷凍|れいとう}{鮪|まぐろ}のせりが{行|おこな}われていた。
examples.english: Frozen tuna auctions were held every morning at Tsukiji Market.

notes:
USAGE:
Often written in katakana (マグロ) at fish markets and restaurants. The main parts sold are: {赤身|あかみ} (lean red meat), {中|ちゅう}トロ (medium-fatty tuna), and {大|おお}トロ (fatty tuna belly), in ascending order of price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮪|まぐろ}の{刺身|さしみ} (tuna sashimi)
- {鮪|まぐろ}{丼|どん} (tuna rice bowl)
- {本|ほん}{鮪|まぐろ} (bluefin tuna)

CULTURE:
New Year tuna auctions at Tokyo's fish market draw international media attention, with record prices reaching hundreds of millions of yen.
